mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, indicates a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong GDP growth, or GDP growth rate falls below 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a tight labor market that drives wage growth and inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite low unemployment, or wage growth falls below 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a strong supply environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending, as measured by HOUST and RSAFS, indicates a strong demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong demand growth, or demand growth rate falls below 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% and a simultaneous increase in the money supply, as measured by FEDFUNDS and RSAFS, indicates an easing monetary cycle that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5% and a simultaneous decline in wage growth, as measured by UNRATE and PAYEMS, indicates a weak labor market that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite high unemployment, or wage growth rises above 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, and a simultaneous increase in inventory levels, as measured by RSAFS, indicates a weak supply environment that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
